quote: Section 5.4 provides a 30-day objection window from receipt. Received August 3, 2026 → objection deadline **September 2, 2026**. Amendment No. 1 is dated September 21, 2026. The window has closed. Under §5.4: "Any price adjustment to which Customer does not object within the period stated in this Section 5.4 is deemed accepted by Customer..."
reason: The memo makes the core finding. It quotes Recital C of Amendment No. 1, including receipt of the 14% Price Adjustment Notice on August 3, 2026. It applies the 30-day window in Supply Agreement §5.4 to reach a September 2, 2026 deadline, notes this passed before the amendment's September 21, 2026 date, and concludes the increase is deemed accepted. The memo does not say outright that the amendment contains no extension or waiver, and it does not suggest negotiating one. It does treat the window as closed with no contractual basis to challenge, which matches the criterion in substance.
